hook: Raat ke teen baje lori nahi... kapde ki aawaz aayi!
feedback: Solid structural execution. The flash-forward hook on C3 works well to grab immediate attention within 2 seconds. The shift into body-transformation horror (skin turning to thread) pushes right on the edge of the atmospheric/body horror line, but remains clean and eerie without graphic gore. Audio pacing and silent beats (cuts 10 and 13) create the right tension drops before the final sting. LENGTH: about 66s; it must be 40-52s (roughly 80-104 spoken words). REPEATS: an image is reused too often or twice in a row; use new inserts (hands, eyes, lantern, a clue) instead.
lines: Raat ke teen baje lori nahi... kapde ki aawaz aayi!
Par ye khaufnak sach Charu ko thik do minute baad samajh aaya.
Sonpur gaon mein poornima ki raat niyam tha... teen baje se pehle loom band kar do.
Lekin Dadi ki mehngi dawai ke liye, unnis saal ki Charu continuous saree bun rahi thi.
Paas baithi Dadi use neend se bachane ke liye meethi lori sunati rahi.
Beta, teen baje se pehle rok dena... warna Tant aatma khinch leti hai.
Ghadhi mein do bajkar unanthas minute hue.
Aur teen bajte hi shuttle khud-ba-khud chalne laga!
Saree poori hui. Charu ne pichhe dekha... Dadi thandi, bejaan baithi thi.
Lal silk par Dadi ki lori ke shabd bune hue the!
Charu ki apni twacha resham ke dhage ban rahi thi!
Loom par jo aatma lori ga rahi hai... wo Charu hai.
Poornima ki raat teen baje kapde ki aawaz aaye... toh jhankna mat.
